description: Use this when someone asks to design, draw or plan a house, apartment, office, room or floor plan, and no plan of theirs fits. Starts a new empty plan to scale in their account and returns its ID. Build it with edit_project and show it with open_editor; do not describe a design in words or generate a picture of it instead.

title.description: The plan's name, such as Lake house.

name: create_project
